meta.title: Beam - Record. Edit. Share.
meta.description: Beam is an open-source screen recorder and video editor for polished product demos.

home.lede: Beam combines capture and editing in one focused desktop app, so product demos stay fast to make and clear to watch.
home.demoAlt: Beam video editor showing a product recording
home.openSourceTitle: Beam is built with its community.
home.openSourceText: Read the code, report a bug, or help make the recorder better.
